concerns.text: T006a is marked completed (X) but declares a dependency on T004 (utils/config.py) which is still pending. This violates the foundational‑first ordering rule.
T006b is marked completed (X) yet depends on T004, which has not been implemented. Consumer tasks must not precede their producers.

T041 (model training) depends on T040 (data aggregation) from User Story 1, making User Story 2 non‑independent. Each user‑story block should be independently shippable; cross‑story dependencies breach this requirement.
T043 (confusion‑matrix visualization) depends on T042c (evaluation) from User Story 2, again tying User Story 3 to prior stories and preventing it from being independently testable.
